predecessors.name: Liang dynasty
predecessors.text: Xiao Ji's domain: he 'governed the modern Sichuan and Chongqing region' as governor of Yi Province; headquarters Chengdu

successors.name: Western Wei
successors.text: Xiao Ji's domain: he 'governed the modern Sichuan and Chongqing region' as governor of Yi Province; headquarters Chengdu

ledger.x: 552: Xiao Ji declares himself emperor in Yi Province.
553: the Western Wei invade Yi Province.
553: Xiao Ji dies and his claim ends.

wars.name: Xiao Yi's war with Xiao Ji and the Western Wei conquest of Yi Province
wars.outcome: Xiao Yi has Xiao Ji put to death in August 553; the Western Wei capture Xiao Ji's domain and keep it.

certainty.note: The extent of Xiao Ji's domain is not given on any page opened.
